description: Fetch a page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com) and return its interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, links, forms), each with a ready-to-use selector, as JSON {url, count, elements:[...]} instead of raw HTML. Use it to discover what to target, then drive the page with the `steps` param of fetch_html.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load before inspecting.

url.description: The absolute URL to load and inspect (http/https).

name: list_elements
title: List interactive page elements
